environment.description: Lambda function deployed with SQS trigger from queue 'oauth-callback-queue'. The SQS queue policy allows sqs:SendMessage from any AWS principal (Principal: '*'). The Lambda function URL is configured with AuthType: NONE. No VPC restrictions on outbound traffic. The OAuth provider (Cognito) does not enforce strict redirect_uri matching - it accepts any redirect_uri that shares the same domain prefix.

config.vpc_config: no VPC attachment, public internet egress
config.oauth_provider: redirect_uri validation uses prefix match only
config.iam_policy: lambda has sqs:ReceiveMessage, sqs:DeleteMessage on queue ARN
